item.title: Surprise! Aspyr Is Remastering A Shrek Game

description.p: [Insert funny Shrek joke here].Aspyr Media, the team behind the recent Lord of the Rings and Middle-earth ports for Nintendo platforms, has apparently got a remaster of Shrek 2 in the pipeline. This announcement has seemingly been leaked ahead of schedule via an official Xbox Store listing. A GTA 6-style promotional trailer has also surfaced online.This action-adventure game was originally released in 2004 on multiple platforms including the GameCube. The Game Boy Advance also got its own version. As for this remaster, according to the now-removed store listing, it will apparently include improved graphics, new features, and up to four-player co-op (local and online).Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Impressions: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Campaign - Switch 2 Does Its Best With One Hell Of A 'Popcorn Game'

description.p: Chutes too narrow?Nearly 13 years since Nintendo gamers last had the chance to answer the Call of Duty (2013's Ghosts on Wii U, RIP), Activision has finally redeployed this storied series on Nintendo platforms.Given the technical gulf between Switch 2 and competition, not to mention PC, the cynical among us might have read Microsoft's agreement to bring the series to a Nintendo console day-and-date with other platforms and expected a compromised, box-ticking Switch port. Something patched up and pushed out with reduced player counts and missing modes, technically running on the handheld, but barely.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Preview: 'Eternal Anima' Returns To The Past To Create A Modern JRPG

description.p: Back to the future.Originally revealed in 2023 as a working title named Project Life is RPG, Marvelous didn't show too much of their new IP, but said they were creating a game that pays respect to the classics of the genre, along with some gorgeous concept art. Jump forward to this year, and Eternal Anima was officially unveiled in September's Nintendo Direct.A bunch of game industry veterans are working on this title, such as Katsuhisa Higuchi (Final Fantasy, Chrono Trigger, Chrono Cross, Xenogears), Kazushige Nojima (Final Fantasy, Kingdom Hearts), and Keisuke Makino (Metaphor: ReFantazio, Persona 5), to name a few.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: "No Offense To Zelda" - Activision Exec Says Call Of Duty: MW4 And GTA 6 Are The Two Biggest Games Of The Year

description.p: How to p*** off Nintendo fans in four words.With most upcoming games fleeing from the November release window to avoid Grand Theft Auto VI, Nintendo is bucking the trend with the launch of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on the 5th – two weeks ahead of Rockstar's epic.It's become quite the talking point in the industry and beyond, with even Saturday Night Live dedicating its weekend update skit to the two titles. However, Activision's chief marketing officer Tyler Bahl downplayed Zelda's potential impact upon launch in an interview with The Game Business, and instead believes that GTA VI will drive more players towards Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

description.p: Taking the Mickey.Famitsu has shared the latest look at the Japanese physical gaming charts, and there's another newbie on the podium.Despite not even reaching the podium in the UK, Kingdom Hearts Collection nabbed the top spot in Japan, with just 23,411 units to its name. Not all that many sales for a debut, but it was a pretty quiet week out there, with Rhythm Heaven Groove landing in second and last week's champ, Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve flying into third.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
